summary: Batch IMS database LOAD program for the pending-authorization database. Reads a sequential input file of authorization summary and detail records and inserts them as segments into the IMS pending-authorization database (root summary segments with their detail children), reporting the number of segments loaded.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize, then loop reading the input file until end-of-file: for each summary record insert an IMS root summary segment, and for each associated detail insert a child detail segment. Count the segments loaded, then report the totals and return.

annotations.note: IMS initial-load: input file records become root (summary) and child (detail) segments in the pending-auth DB.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the input file and initialize counters.

paragraphs.name: 2000-READ-INPUT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next input record; set end-of-file at the end.

paragraphs.name: 3000-LOAD-SUMMARY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Insert (ISRT) a pending-authorization summary root segment into IMS from the input record; abend on error.

paragraphs.name: 4000-LOAD-DETAIL
paragraphs.pseudocode: Insert (ISRT) a pending-authorization detail child segment under the current summary; abend on error.

paragraphs.name: 9000-FINALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the input file and display the counts of segments loaded.
